deck_title: Enterprise Video Object Removal & Dynamic Brand Prop Replacement: SAM-2 Memory Mask + ProPainter Optical-Flow Completion + Wan-VACE Latent Tube (c_tube = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Per-Frame 2D Shimmer

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Video Object Removal & Brand Prop Replacement pipeline evaluation (tracking occluded props/passersby via SAM-2 memory bank, propagating known background pixels across distant frames via ProPainter bidirectional optical-flow completion, and synthesizing new 2026 SKU props inside a 3D Wan-VACE spatiotemporal latent tube while freezing 92% of non-masked pixels so amortized unit cost c_tube(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_tube = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive frame-by-frame 2D image inpainting (which hallucinates conflicting background textures on every frame, causing water-ripple jelly shimmer and inflating rework cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-frame flow-tube quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Erasing photobombing passersby, boom mics, wire rigs, and competitor billboards from moving-camera commercial footage
Replacing legacy product packaging (2024 bottle/phone) in archive TVCs with the 2026 new SKU while preserving actor hand-grip finger occlusion
Combining ProPainter bidirectional optical-flow pixel propagation (85% real background reuse) with DiffuEraser / Wan-VACE 3D latent-tube synthesis
not_for: Running single-image 2D LaMa or SD Inpainting frame-by-frame on video (creates boiling "Predator cloak" water-ripple shimmer)
Omitting cast shadows from the object removal mask (leaves a dark ghost shadow walking across the floor)
